stride_threats.description: Path traversal (e.g. src/../tests/...) or symlink bypasses is_protected_path() string prefix matching, allowing Developer role to tamper with specs/ or tests/.
Shell command regex blacklist in run_command hook can be bypassed via python -c, tee, git, or subshells to modify protected tests/ or specs/.
Stop hook trusts workspacePaths[0] from stdin JSON as subprocess cwd for pytest/unittest execution without validating against repository root, and does not catch subprocess.TimeoutExpired.
Non-positive inverse temperature (beta <= 0) or invalid mode strings produce division-by-zero or silent fallback in anomaly and gap detection.
